items.title: Rupee may open firmer as crude oil prices fall
items.text: Reuters reported on 3 November that the Indian rupee was expected to open at ₹94.75–₹94.78 per US dollar, after closing at ₹94.90 on Monday. Brent crude had fallen 11%, improving the outlook for India, which imports about 90% of its oil requirement. Dollar strength and technical resistance could limit the rupee’s gains.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu prompts heavy-rain alerts across five states
items.text: The Economic Times reported that the India Meteorological Department forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall in parts of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Odisha and Chhattisgarh on 3 November. Cyclone Murasu was expected to weaken after crossing the south Andhra Pradesh coast. Residents were advised to follow local administration instructions and official weather updates.

items.title: Strong El Niño episode continues to intensify
items.text: A report published by Le Monde on 3 November said the current El Niño has continued to strengthen and could peak near the end of 2026. The Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature anomaly was around 3.5°C at the end of October. Scientists linked the episode with weather disruptions including drought and wildfires, while noting that other climate factors also influence regional impacts.

items.title: Supreme Court allows limited green-firecracker use in Delhi-NCR
items.text: The Supreme Court permitted certified green firecrackers in Delhi-NCR on 7 and 8 November for specified time windows: 6–7 a.m. and 8–10 p.m. The order also establishes 300-metre no-firecracker zones around hospitals, educational institutions and other protected places. The complete ban is to resume from 9 November.

items.title: All 10 candidates elected unopposed to IOA Athletes’ Commission
items.text: The Times of India reported that the Indian Olympic Association’s Athletes’ Commission election scheduled for 3 November will not be held because all 10 candidates for the five male and five female positions were declared elected unopposed. Withdrawals by two nominees left one candidate for each position across the categories.
